Interface Context

All Known Implementing Classes:
ChildContext, DefaultContext
public interface Context
The internal resolution engine. Richer than Injector but accessible to Factory so generated factories can resolve their dependencies. The default implementation is DefaultContext.

    • createScoped

      default <T> T createScoped(ScopedProduct product, @Nullable Consumer<? super T> preDestroy, Function<? super Context, ? extends T> instance)
      Creates the instance of a child-local assisted product, and caches it in the nearest context of the chain that hosts its scope, by its key. Generated assisted factories call this for a recipe with a child-local scope.

      The default rejects every call, so minimal Context implementations need not host scopes.

      Type Parameters:
      T - the product type
      Parameters:
      product - the product to create
      preDestroy - the product's @PreDestroy callback, run when its host closes, or null
      instance - builds the instance through the context it is given: the host's, so the product's dependencies resolve where it is cached
      Returns:
      the created instance
      Throws:
      ScopeResolutionException - if no context of the chain hosts the product's scope
      IllegalStateException - if the host already holds an instance of the product

    • close

      default void close()
      Destroys this context's scoped instances (invoking their @PreDestroy callbacks) and marks it closed. The default is a no-op for minimal implementations. Idempotent.
